reason: A conservative CLI for inspecting Claude Code and Codex plugins, assessing component compatibility, and generating auditable DeepSeek Harness bundles from supported static content.

summaries.zh: 用于检查 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件兼容性，并将支持的静态内容转换为可审计 DeepSeek Harness 软件包的命令行工具。
summaries.en: A command-line tool that inspects Claude Code and Codex plugin compatibility and converts supported static content into auditable DeepSeek Harness bundles.

capabilities: Inspect plugin manifests and component metadata
Classify plugin components by compatibility state
Convert supported static content into DeepSeek Harness bundles
Generate compatibility reports, source maps, ownership locks, and SHA-256 digests
Perform deterministic static validation without executing source plugin code
